summary.text: Mari Leavitt is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 28-Position 1 since January 14, 2019, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Leavitt was assigned to the Capital Budget Committee, the Housing Committee, the College & Workforce Development Committee, the House Rules Committee and the Joint Veterans' and Military Affairs Committee during the 2023-2024 session, according to Ballotpedia.
